notes.content:
BANKED DURING SLEEP HOURS (00:20 SGT 2026-08-28) per CLAUDE.md hard rule. Recorded, NOT
acted on. Pick up after 06:00.

Maintainer verbatim: 'okay, i want you to do the font rescue in this manner. skrifa first,
our decoder second, and hayro last.'

  now:  ours -> skrifa -> hayro          (landed in c09a189, gh-90)
  want: skrifa -> ours  -> hayro

REVERSES A DELIBERATE CALL -- re-examine, do not silently drop the reasoning. I put ours
first because test-annotation.pdf already renders 100% with our engine (0 advance-box
glyphs), so skrifa-first changes rendering for every glyph that ALREADY WORKS. Maintainer
asked for skrifa-first anyway, which is legitimate: skrifa is far more battle-tested than
our from-spec decoders, so 'most correct engine first' is defensible and arguably better
long-term. Instruction stands -- but it raises the verification bar.

WORK:
 1. Invert FontProgram::outline: currently primary.outline(gid).or_else(skrifa); make it
    skrifa-then-primary. Advance box (=> hayro) still last.
 2. Makes bd-ulz LOAD-BEARING, not optional: with skrifa first, a font our decoders reject
    entirely SHOULD still render, but parse() only succeeds when primary does, and
    select_gid() in font.rs resolves GIDs solely against primary encoding/charset tables.
    font.rs needs a skrifa-aware GID path. (font.rs was outside the previous agent's owned
    paths -- that is why it was untouched.)
 3. Type1 /FontFile unaffected: outside skrifa's OpenType scope, stays with glyph_type1.rs.
 4. DO NOT touch hayro. Stays last. Maintainer twice explicit it is not to be deleted.

VERIFICATION BAR IS HIGHER THAN LAST TIME -- a green suite is NOT sufficient, because this
changes rendering for glyphs that currently work:
  * scan-fallback on test-annotation.pdf must still be 0 pages.
  * Rasterise the same pages before/after and DIFF PIXELS. A large unexplained delta means
    skrifa and our decoders disagree about real glyphs -- understand it BEFORE shipping.
  * outline_prefers_primary_over_skrifa asserts the OLD order by name and behaviour. INVERT
    AND RENAME it, do not delete -- the rename is the record that the order changed on
    purpose.

STILL WANTED: a font our decoders fail and skrifa rescues. Turns this from 'wired' to
'demonstrated'. Likely the LaTeX dissertation from gh-31 / bd-515.

title: kopitiam-pdf: invert glyph rescue order -- skrifa first, our decoders second, hayro last
